types.description: Abstract base layout — the shared root subtype for object-level UI surfaces. A layout attaches a presentation concern (grids, forms, tabs, cards) to an object. The base carries no attrs of its own; concrete subtypes add their presentation attrs.
A metadata-driven data grid attached to an object: declares the displayed columns, page size, default sort, and an optional preset filter the generated grid renders.

children.name: pageSize
children.description: Number of rows per page in the generated data grid.

children.name: defaultSortField
children.description: Field name the grid is sorted by on initial render. Must reference an actual field on the entity.

children.name: defaultSortOrder
children.description: Initial sort direction for the default sort field: 'asc' or 'desc'.

children.name: filterable
children.description: When true, the generated grid exposes column filtering UI.

children.name: filter
children.description: Structured preset filter object applied to the grid at the metadata level. Desugared to canonical { field: { op: value } } form at parse time.

children.name: columns
children.description: Flat ordered list of field names to display as grid columns.
